notes.text:
An update is available for netpbm.
This update affects Rocky Linux 10.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
The netpbm packages contain tools and a library to manipulate the Netpbm graphics file formats, and tools for conversion of other graphics formats to and from Netpbm.

Security Fix(es):

* netpbm: netpbm: Arbitrary code execution via crafted PICT file in picttoppm (CVE-2026-120433)

* netpbm: netpbm: Arbitrary code execution via integer overflow in winicontopam (CVE-2026-120432)

* netpbm: netpbm: Arbitrary code execution via integer overflow in jbigtopnm (CVE-2026-120436)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
